paper_title: On the Chromatic Number of Disjointness Graphs of Curves
statement: We proved that the best χ-bounding function for the family of disjointness graphs of xmonotone curves satisfies f (k) = Θ(k 4 ). What can we say about the chromatic number of Kk -free families of disjointness graphs of segments or convex sets? For both of these families, the best known upper bound on the chromatic number is also O(k 4 ), but there are no matching lower bounds.
